behavior.locked: Explicit medal requirement; View event opens existing Career briefing without mutating progression. Back or Garage returns to the source Upgrade category and level, preserving prior event context.
behavior.insufficientCredits: Balance and price remain visible; the exact MISSING amount is red beside the action. Unaffordable level prices are red. Earn credits opens the replayable reward event. Medal and credit blockers are shown together.
behavior.purchase: Effects, tradeoff, stock comparison, cost beside Buy and equip. Back initially focused; transaction rechecks price, ownership and unlock.
behavior.owned: Equip · Free confirmation; no credit charge.
behavior.skippedLevel: View Level N opens the next required upgrade instead of skipping purchases.
behavior.presentation: Authored serialized content inside the existing Confirmation panel; opaque background, yellow requirement and existing red focus style.
